description:
> *Generated by AI from docs/research/c-verification-macos.md.*

An opt-in mode (env or config) adding -fsanitize=address,undefined (or UBSan trap-only) -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer. Must enter the build cache key: in the spike an ASan build was silently reused by a later normal run and once replaced the library in _build/test/lib/defk/ebin (overlaps defk-srh). In this mode, poison the CHICKEN_PAD slack ERTS adds after enif_alloc_binary buffers in defk_own_raw so 1-byte overruns are caught on a stock emulator. Benchmarks (Defk.Bench) must refuse or warn in this mode.
title: Sanitizer build mode in Defk.Build (ASan/UBSan), part of the cache key, never used for benchmarks
